CustomField.description: Staging mirror routed to GiftTransaction.FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c on commit. Convention: one year past the transaction's date. Blank means no time restriction on the transaction. Paired with FQS_GC_Restriction_Release_Date__c on the commitment side — Salesforce enforces one GiftEntry source field to one destination field per FieldMappingConfig, so GC and GT need separate staging columns. See docs/gift-entry-field-mapping.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date restricted funds from this payment become available for either general use or for their designated purpose. Populates onto the Gift Transaction on commit.
CustomField.label: Restriction Release Date (GT)
